name: Department of Archaeology — gazetted protected monuments, Rangpur Division (district PDF lists)
organization: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
attribution: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
notes: Page 'রংপুর বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district (published 2024-08-31 for 7 districts, Thakurgaon 2025-07-13; 59 monuments). PDFs are Bijoy/SutonnyMJ-encoded Word exports; text converted to Unicode by fetch.py (bijoy2uni) and spot-checked against rendered pages; three conversion slips fixed (TEXT_FIXES_BY_DIV). Coordinates are the DoA's own GPS column (DMS / decimal degrees, parsed); out-of-range values are not used (kept in extra_json). QA against hdx_cod_ab_bgd_rangpur polygons. Descriptions (column 7) are not copied; only a construction-date phrase is kept. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
